audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with the already-audited mirror (karma__yorick) on rows 2, 3 and 6, and diffRating read 7.5/10 (hard) on a matchup Yorick wins.
audit.why: The mirror settled the chart as Karma, Karma, Skill, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick, Yorick and rated it 8/10 difficulty / 8/10 carry threat from Karma's side. Inverted, Yorick's side must read the same rows with inverse ratings, and a matchup that hard for Karma cannot be 7.5/10 for Yorick.
audit.corrected: win[1]/phases[1].side to Karma, win[2]/phases[2].side to Skill, win[4]/phases[4].side to Yorick, with ratings 3/10, 5/10, 7/10; diffRating 4/10 and carryRating 4/10, and every prose line quoting those numbers updated.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why and whys[4] claimed Karma's ultimate 'changes the math' at 6 and called level 6 skill-based, while the row said Karma.
audit.why: Mantra requires no skill point and is available from level 1, so Karma has no level-6 spike at all; Yorick's Eulogy of the Isles is the only power turn there. Yorick's real spikes are Mourning Mist at 3 (12s at rank 1, slow plus armour shred that his ghouls sprint toward), Maiden at 6, then first item.
audit.corrected: Rewrote phases[1].why, phases[2].why, phases[4].why, whys[1], whys[2], whys[4] to those spikes and to match the corrected rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: The cooldown block gave no numbers: Focused Resolve had no cooldown or range, and Dark Procession was described only as 'your committal tool'.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s tether at 675 range that only roots if it survives, so leaving her range is the counterplay and the number tells you when stepping up is safe. Dark Procession is 20s at rank 1. Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve also heals her, which the page never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Real cooldowns and the 675-range tether break moved into breakdown.cooldowns and dosFull[0].d; Dark Procession's 20s into dontsFull[1].d; Grievous Wounds into the itemization line.

audit.whatIsWrong: No anti-heal guidance despite the missing-interaction flag.
audit.why: Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve heals Karma, so extended trades and dives swing on Grievous Wounds timing.
